Fixes #107

## Summary
- Routes Russian URL-request prompts such as `Сделай запрос к google.com` to `http_fetch` instead of the unknown fallback.
- Adds explicit `web_search` routing in Rust and the browser worker; the static browser demo uses the CORS-readable Wikipedia REST search endpoint and renders ranked links.
- Preserves `iframeUrl` through worker/app message memory so CORS-blocked page fetches show the iframe fallback reliably.
- Adds issue #107 case-study data under `docs/case-studies/issue-107/`, including raw issue/PR data, provider probe results, and web-capture research.
- Filed upstream web-capture search-provider API request: https://github.com/link-assistant/web-capture/issues/130

## Reproduction And Fix
- Reproduced the reported prompt with a unit regression first: `Сделай запрос к google.com` previously resolved to `intent: unknown`.
- The Rust solver now extracts URLs from English and Russian request phrasing and registers `web_search` after `http_fetch`.
- The browser worker mirrors that parsing, attempts direct `fetch()` for URL requests, falls back to an iframe when blocked, and uses Wikipedia search for explicit web-search prompts.

## Provider Research
- `https://link-assistant.github.io/formal-ai/tests` currently returns HTTP 404 with `connect-src 'self'`, so the browser probe records that and falls back to `https://link-assistant.github.io/formal-ai/`.
- Browser CORS fetches from the deployed app origin failed for Google, Bing, DuckDuckGo, and Brave search URLs.
- Wikipedia REST search and summary endpoints returned readable HTTP 200 JSON, so Wikipedia is the implemented static-demo search provider.

## Verification
- `cargo fmt --all -- --check`
- `cargo clippy --all-targets --all-features`
- `cargo test --test unit prompt_returns -- --nocapture`
- `cargo test --all-features --verbose`
- `cargo test --doc --verbose`
- `rust-script scripts/check-file-size.rs` (passes; warning-only for pre-existing near-limit `src/solver_helpers.rs` and `src/seed.rs`)
- `npm ci` in `tests/e2e`
- `npm run test:local -- --grep "Russian URL request|explicit web search"` in `tests/e2e`
- `npm run test:local` in `tests/e2e`
- `node experiments/issue-107-browser-provider-probe.mjs`
